supersedes: stash_selection_definitions_v1 (my proposal; kept as history; no actual results were inspected under either version)
root_amendments: root's frozen scientific choices of 2026-09-06; not a David approval item

origins.source: basic cohort rows of run 20260906T195728Z (a row exists if the player appeared in t or t-1); identity must be resolved

contribution_bars.primary_meaning: deep-roster relevance counts (DG-165); the bar is the N-th highest DG-179 championship points among the FULL positional outcome panel of that season (all cohort rows of the position), never among selected candidates
contribution_bars.strict_meaning: positional-depth scenario, not a guaranteed lineup gain; no starter claim
contribution_bars.contributor: appeared AND points >= bar, so a zero bar never creates a contributor from an absent record

cohort_primary.name: drafted early-career not-yet-contributor screen
cohort_primary.rule: verified draft class c with c <= t (visible at origin), 1 <= t - c + 1 <= 3, and NO season s in c..t with (appeared AND DG-179 points_s >= primary bar of season s); resolved absent row = explicit convention zero
cohort_primary.not: all stash/waiver candidates; no contemporary roster eligibility; draft absence is unknown, not UDFA

cohort_exploratory.name: observed-history stratum
cohort_exploratory.rule: seasons_played (stat-row seasons observed since 2005) <= 3 at origin; no draft requirement

primary_test.name: summed future
primary_test.future_ranking: policy_e_points_year2 + policy_e_points_year3 from the frozen producer, required finite for both (missing forecast origins are counted exclusions, never zero, never fatal)
primary_test.outcome_points: realized DG-179 points in t+2 plus t+3 (both closed: origins <= 2022)
comparators_on_identical_candidates: frozen policy year-1 expected points (help now)
persistence comparator: baseline_e_points_year2 + year3 (total_points_t x training retention x appearance rate; within a cell it orders like all-games production)

immediate_help_test.outcome: realized DG-179 points and contributor in t+1

exploratory_secondary.disclosure: frozen year 5 exists for origin 2020 ONLY (one-origin evidence, stated prominently)

budgets.meaning: declared scenarios, not David's optimal allocation

uncertainty.method: paired player-cluster bootstrap of ordering differences
uncertainty.conditional_on: realized origins and the fixed frozen fits; no future-season or model-selection uncertainty is claimed
disclosures: cells with fewer rows than the bar count

label_ledger.artifact_row: DG-179 row (including true row-backed zero or negative points)
label_ledger.no_record_zero: resolved identity, covered season, no DG-179 row: convention zero
label_ledger.open_season: target season after the last complete season: excluded and counted; never zero
label_ledger.no_record_as_unknown_sensitivity: fixed selections report lower/upper hit bounds treating no-record rows as unknown

claims_not_made: waiver or availability backtest (no point-in-time ownership source): a historical low-production candidate screen
an untouched confirmation: the policy was selected historically on these folds; this is a retrospective frozen-policy evaluation
